name: Polterware classic material
snapshot: 2026-10-29, taken from commit b3e0b12 working tree before the OpenCode material change
purpose: Exact copies of the previous material so it can be compared or restored. Reference only: these files are not imported or built.

files.base.css: packages/configuration/tailwind/base.css (tokens: edge light, card rings, field wells, texture tones, keycaps, radii; mirrored material classes)
files.materials.css: packages/frontend/design-system/src/materials.css (surface-panel, surface-panel-float, control-field, pw-field-control, menu-panel, texture faces, card-panel rings)

material_summary.cards: card fill gradient (#292929 → #242424) with four inset concentric hairlines (#1d1d1d, #323232, #191919, #2e2e2e) inside a 1px white 10% border, plus a 2px/1px drop
material_summary.texture_buttons: 1px dark frame, lit outer gradient (#5c5c5c → #3d3d3d), inner face gradient (#262626 → #3b3b3b) on ::before
material_summary.keycaps: white-to-grey key body with a dished face, solid lip and 2px press travel
material_summary.switch: field-well track, grey gradient when on, raised texture thumb
